Misinformation on price. I was excited to get this app as I have over 50 house plants. Firstly when you sign up for purchase options you have to”lifetime” $49.99 (one payment) or “7 days” (auto renewal) $6.99. Why wouldn’t you choose the lifetime one payment? Seemed very reasonable as I would be using it for a long time, but no it is not a lifetime purchase. I paid the 49.99 & after about 6 months or so it needed renewal for.. wait.. guess… that’s right another $49.99. Nah man. Lifetime should be lifetime implies one time purchase. I did actually like the app which sucked, but for the little I’d use it, which was to diagnose diseases, I’m not spending that kind of money it’s NOT worth that.
